The Sager family is proud of their enduring relationships with their wholesalers and suppliers, some whom have been a part of Winesellers portfolio from the very [...] 2021
Award-winning importer Winesellers announces the partnership as the exclusive USA importer for OTU Estate Wines. OTU Estate, which now produces Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Noir, Rosé and Pinot Gris with Hawkes Bay Chardonnay complimenting the range, is located directly south of Marlborough, in the Awatere Valley; the coolest and driest of Marlborough’s three sub-regions.

History
This is not just a story of wine, this is a story about family
A look back into our past
Founded in 1978 by Yale Sager, Winesellers Limited began as a one-man operation and selling wines primarily in the Midwest. Over the last four decades, Winesellers has evolved into a globally recognized importer and marketer of family-owned wineries and brands produced in both well-known and unique regions from around the world. The Sager family is proud of their enduring relationships with their wholesalers and suppliers, some whom have been a part of Winesellers portfolio from the very beginning.

1978
Dr. Pauly Bergweiler partners with Winesellers. Dr. Pauly-Bergweiler is owned by Dr. Peter Pauly and his wife Helga, both of whom are traditional advocates of noble wines. The vineyards are mainly planted on, difficult-to-cultivate river valley hillsides and are planted predominantly with late maturity Riesling grapes, which place high demands on their location.

1986
Pierre Lafond from Santa Barbara Winery & Lafond Winery Vineyards partners with Winesellers. In 1962, at the age of thirty-two, Pierre Lafond founded the first post-prohibition commercial winery in Santa Barbara County. Two years later, he located a winery facility on Anacapa Street, just two blocks from the Pacific Ocean.

1995
Winesellers partners with Familia Zuccardi (Zuccardi Valle de Uco and Bodega Santa Julia). Since the beginning, this 3rd generation family owned winery Zuccardi Valle de Uco have focused on innovation, quality and sustainable production. Today they believe that the future of Argentine wine is bright and are committed to showing the world the best terroirs that can be found in Argentina.

2002
Besserat de Bellefon from Champagne partners with Winesellers. Born by the water on the countryside around “Aÿ“ in 1843, Besserat de Bellefon leaves its mark on Parisian hotspots, from “Le Louvre“ to “Orsay“ to “Le Palais de l’Elysée“.

2003
Hacienda Araucano partners with Winesellers. Today, François Lurton continues to explore other possibilities, including planting grape vines that require cooler temperatures at higher altitudes, such as Cabernet or Pinot Noir. The goal is to produce distinguished, authentic, original wines.

2004
Master Wines partners with Winesellers. Masterwines was started by Mel and Janie Master in France in 1990 when its main business was sourcing great value wines from the Languedoc region of the south of France.

2012
Quinta de la Rosa partners with Winesellers. Quinta de la Rosa is a pioneering Single Quinta winery famed for its premium wines and ports. It is also know for its idyllic hotel and restaurant.

2014
Winesellers, a national importer and marketer of international wines, and Vinum Cellars, an innovative California wine producer owned by winemakers Richard Bruno and Chris Condos, have announced a national sales and distribution agreement.

2017
Carlos Serres partners with Winesellers. Carlos Serres the man came from Bordeaux in the late 19th century, after phylloxera had devastated the wine industry in the Médoc. Carlos Serres was a pioneer in Rioja. In 1896 he established one of the first wineries in Haro, the wine capital of Rioja. He was an instrumental figure in promoting the early exports of Rioja wines.

2018
Prosper Maufoux Domaine partners with Winesellers. Founded in 1860, Prosper Maufoux has always aimed to preserve the unique terroir of Burgundy by sourcing grapes from prime climates and appellations in the region. The house is now owned and operated by the Piffaut family, key players in Burgundy wine production since 1898, who are also proprietors of Chteau de Saint-Aubin in Chassagne-Montrachet.

2021
Award-winning importer Winesellers announces the partnership as the exclusive USA importer for OTU Estate Wines. OTU Estate, which now produces Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Noir, Rosé and Pinot Gris with Hawkes Bay Chardonnay complimenting the range, is located directly south of Marlborough, in the Awatere Valley; the coolest and driest of Marlborough’s three sub-regions.

2022
Winesellers, Ltd., a second-generation family-owned importer and marketer of fine wines, announces a new partnership as exclusive U.S. importer of Bodegas Volver, the renowned Spanish grower and producer of fine wines from regions including La Mancha,Alicante, Almansa, and Jumilla.

2023
A new partnership with iconic family-owned Italian producer Piccini 1882 as the exclusive U.S importer of the namesake brand, Piccini. Founded by Angiolo Piccini in 1882 and now managed by fourth-generation family members Mario and Martina Piccini, this 130-year-old family estate exports and distributes wines to more than 90 countries and produced more than 32-million bottles in 2022.

2026
Winesellers, Ltd., the award-winning, second-generation family-owned importer and marketer of fine wines, proudly announces a renewed partnership with Les Vins Georges Duboeuf, the iconic French wine producer. This collaboration is more than a business alliance—it’s a story of heritage, legacy, and endurance. Decades ago, Georges Duboeuf joined forces with Yale Sager to introduce Beaujolais wines to American consumers. Today, this story comes full circle as Duboeuf’s grandson Adrien Duboeuf-Lacombe partners with brothers Adam Sager and Jordan Sager, ushering in a new era for Beaujolais in the U.S.

VinAccessGlobal
Select Page
Meet the team
130+ Years of combined experience for your success!
Alison
Alison Harvey
Founder at VinAccessGlobal
Alison has lived and worked in Singapore since 2002. She originally came to establish a network of importers for what is now Henkell-Freixenet, and since 2021 has been managing her own business connecting small to medium sized wine producers from all over the world with the right partners in Asia Pacific.
Alison studied languages at university before starting work in the retail sector of the wine trade in London. After completing the WSET Diploma with honours she became the first ever female sales representative in the Waverley Vintners team, before transferring to the fine wine merchant, Christopher & Co. After this role she spent several years as Sales Director of Geoffrey Roberts Agencies in London before moving to Melbourne as Trade Marketing Manager at Domaine Chandon and subsequently GM Sales and Marketing at Wingara Wine Group.
Connect with Alison
Salvatore Campione
Sales Director – Asia
Salvatore Campione relocated to Asia in 2003 and is based in Thailand. Fluent in Thai, English, French and Italian, he holds a WSET Level 3 certification and has been active in the wine industry since 2005.
He began his career within the commercial team of one of Thailand’s leading wine and spirits importers, gaining first-hand experience across both on-trade and off-trade channels. Over the past 12 years, Salvatore has served as Sales Director for Asia Pacific & Middle East at Talamonti Winery (Abruzzo, Italy), where he has been responsible for building and managing distribution networks across multiple Asian and international markets.
With deep knowledge of the Asia Pacific region and a strong network of importers, distributors and trade professionals, Salvatore specializes in developing sustainable market strategies for wineries, combining commercial discipline with a pragmatic, hands-on approach.
Passionate about wine and international business development, Salvatore enjoys connecting producers with the right partners and turning long-term relationships into measurable growth. He believes that trust, loyalty, consistency and presence in the market are the foundations of successful wine brands in Asia.
Connect with Salvatore
Michelle
Mike Ritchie 
Mike Ritchie MW
VinAccessGlobal Associate – London
Mike was born in London but lived in Paris in his teenage years. He is married with 2 daughters. His working life started with Saccone & Speed as a graduate trainee and he has since gained a diverse wealth of experience during over 40 years in the wine business, including seven years during the early stages of London City Bond, even selling wine on the Shopping Channel alongside Ken Hom and co-hosting a local Cable TV wine show! In 2002, Mike passed his MW and was awarded the commercial and business-related Errazuriz prize. Since 2013, he has worked in a sales role for Freixenet Copestick, the UK division of the German sekt producer Henkell Freixenet.
Most recently, he has added his experience to the sales team at Jascots. He has judged on many wine competitions over the years. His desert island wine would be Schloss Johannisberg’s Silberlack Riesling Trocken, or Aresti’s Trisquel Series Altitude Merlot. He’s happy in the kitchen, rambling for fun or surfing at Polzeath.
Connect with Mike
Clive Weston
VinAccessGlobal Associate – New Zealand
Clive joined Saccone & Speed, a prominent UK wine shipper in 1973, following vintage work at Chateau Cantenac Brown, Margaux. After five years in wine production and five years in sales, he joined specialist New World wine importer Geoffrey Roberts Associates as UK Sales Director.
He entered the New Zealand Wine Trade in 1988, as country manager for the Hill-Smith family and ran Negociants New Zealand, a national importer & distribution business. He also headed up the prestigious Nautilus Estate of Marlborough winery, which exports to forty countries. “Graduating” from Negociants New Zealand in May 2021, Clive now works freelance as a wine consultant to New Zealand wineries and to overseas producers wishing to market wines in New Zealand, notably via VinAccessGlobal. He is also a published wine and food writer and co-founder, with his wife, in a flourishing nutrition enterprise.
Connect with Clive
Clive
Michelle
Michelle Ki
VinAccessGlobal Associate
Michelle was born in Korea and relocated to Singapore in 2016, where she began her career in food and beverage in an international hotel. In 2022 she moved into wine distribution gaining extensive experience dealing with hotels and restaurants, joining VinAccessGlobal in 2025. Michelle will focus on the Korean and Japanese markets, growing our partners business and expanding the customer base within each market.
She views wine not merely as a beverage, but as a powerful connector between people. She is dedicated to fostering strong, trust-based relationships with clients through the rich narratives and experiences that wine embodies.
Connect with Michelle
Emily Nguyen
VinAccessGlobal Administration Assistant
Emily Nguyen joins Vinaccess Global with over 7 years of extensive experience in the  
import-export field and administrative operations. Prior to joining the company, she served as a Senior Administrative Assistant at Pacific Wine Merchant, one of Vietnam’s premier importers and distributors. In this capacity, Emily significantly solidified her expertise in international trade, logistics management, and complex customs procedures, ensuring seamless flow in the supply chain.
At Vinaccess Global, Emily leverages her sharp organizational mindset and hands-on  
operational experience to streamline internal processes. Her dedication to excellence ensures that our clients enjoy consistent, reliable access to the world’s finest wines. She is deeply inspired to align with Vinaccess Global’s international vision, fostering meaningful connections between global suppliers, distributors, and customers across the worldwide market.
Connect with Emily
Kieu 
Michelle
Emma Shaw
VinAccessGlobal Associate
Emma was born and raised in the Barossa Valley, South Australia on a farm with multiple functions including vineyards, supplying some of the well established wineries back in the day. After finishing school and moving to Adelaide, Emma quickly took a shine to wine during her long career in Hospitality, with a highlight running the famed Universal Wine Bar for Australia’s first Master of Wine. A natural progression was to move onto the distribution/sales side, working for Negociants Australia for over 6 years before moving onto Domestic/Export Manager for 2 South Australian Producers with these latter roles spanning 11+ years.
Post Covid, Emma has been specialising as a Sales Consultant for various South Australian producers, and joined Vin Access Global in September 2024, bringing to us her vast knowledge of local and international markets, as well as wide network of contacts.
Connect with Emma
Tiziano Negri
VinAccessGlobal Associate – Italy
Tiziano was born and raised in Veneto, one of the world’s most renowned wine regions. He holds a degree in Viticulture and Enology, with a thesis focused on the B2B wine market. His professional journey includes winery experience in France, Italy, and New Zealand with producers such as Chteau d’Esclans and Marchesi Frescobaldi.
He is excited to join VinAccessGlobal, whose international mindset and mission to connect producers, importers, and distributors worldwide align perfectly with his own vision and passion for the global wine trade.
Tiziano also deeply enjoys sharing wines from around the world with friends and wine lovers, discussing the history behind each bottle and the unique perceptions it inspires.
Connect with Tiziano
Tiziano
Michelle
Kenji Arai
VinAccessGlobal Associate – Tokyo
Kenji was born and raised in Tokyo, he is a wine industry professional with over 20 years of experience. His career began with a California winery, followed by roles at French and Spanish wine company, where he spent many years developing the Japanese market.
He specializes in market strategy, nationwide distribution, and regulatory compliance, with a proven track record of executing global strategies across both retail and on-trade channels. His experience spans international business development, strategic account management, new customer acquisition, product launches, and distribution network expansion throughout Japan.
Connect with Kenji
Michael Jenni
VinAccessGlobal Associate – Indonesia
Based in Bali since 2020, Michael’s background combines a strong understanding of hospitality and business development with first-hand knowledge of how hotels, restaurants, and other wine businesses operate in the Indonesian market.
Michael’s role is to provide sustainable access to the Indonesian market for VinAccessGlobal’s producer partners through relationships, identifying opportunities, implementing strategy, and supporting importers, distributors, hotels, restaurants, and retailers with on-the-ground execution.
